nodes.label: Weather via Open-Meteo

nodes.label: Equalizer That Follows the Music
nodes.rationale: Only loudness read, nothing recorded

nodes.label: GIF Crash Proofing
nodes.rationale: Holm validates every GIF itself; broken/oversized shows GIF unavailable

nodes.label: Holm website
nodes.rationale: Static HTML with no production dependencies, framework runtime, remote fonts, analytics or third-party scripts.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages hosting recommendation
nodes.rationale: Source, releases and workflow already in the repo; no server functions or credentials needed; compared against Cloudflare Pages, Vercel, Netlify.

nodes.label: Live Camera Monitoring (Media Foundation)
nodes.rationale: No camera opened or frames read; privacy records remain fallback

nodes.label: Incoming File Notification Chime
nodes.rationale: Bundled sound works independently of Windows sound scheme

nodes.label: Discord Stale Call Fix
nodes.rationale: Sensor records must match executable path and pre-running process

nodes.label: Live Microphone Monitoring
nodes.rationale: Older privacy records can go stale; reads activity metadata, never audio

nodes.label: src/releases.mjs
nodes.rationale: Accepts only HTTPS URLs under the official repo's release paths; escapes notes before rendering a limited Markdown subset.

nodes.label: Main download selection (newest stable with Holm.exe)
nodes.norm_label: main download selection (newest stable with holm.exe)

nodes.label: Spring Open / Glide Close Animation
nodes.rationale: Opening no longer waits for audio output list or first layout

nodes.label: Topmost Check Only When Covered
nodes.rationale: Topmost re-assert every 1.5s caused ~40 redraws/min; idle CPU 0.7-1.3s to 0.3-0.5s per minute

nodes.label: Background Bluetooth Battery Scan
nodes.rationale: Enumeration in background so it cannot stall the notch; skip if previous scan running

nodes.label: Fewer Unnecessary Redraws
nodes.rationale: Clock updates only on minute change, volume visuals only on value change

nodes.label: Long Friend Code
nodes.rationale: Backward compatibility for friends on Holm older than 1.10

nodes.label: Friend Requests Stay Open Until Answered
nodes.norm_label: friend requests stay open until answered
nodes.rationale: 2-minute auto-withdraw could remove friends who already said yes

nodes.label: Invite Codes (HOLM-XXXXX-XXXXX)
nodes.rationale: Short codes valid 12h for everyone; no acceptance needed, making adding friends easy

nodes.label: Focumon for Holm Browser Extension
nodes.rationale: Talks to Holm on 127.0.0.1 only

nodes.label: Sky when nothing plays (time-of-day and weather colours)
nodes.norm_label: sky when nothing plays (time-of-day and weather colours)
nodes.rationale: Drawn once and kept still so it costs no CPU.

nodes.label: Today at a glance and notch tools
nodes.norm_label: today at a glance and notch tools

nodes.label: Clipboard history privacy and password wipe
nodes.norm_label: clipboard history privacy and password wipe
nodes.rationale: Respects ExcludeClipboardContentFromMonitorProcessing; compares sequence numbers so the password is never read.

nodes.label: Focumon integration in the notch

nodes.community_name: Focumon integration in the not group
nodes.rationale: Unpacked Chrome/Edge extension that reads the Focumon timer; posts only to 127.0.0.1:47631 so nothing leaves the PC.

nodes.label: GifInspector
nodes.rationale: Walks every GIF in safe code before Windows' decoder so malformed files cannot crash Holm; fuzzed with 3000 damaged GIFs.

nodes.label: Beam (formerly AirDrop)
nodes.rationale: Renamed because AirDrop is Apple's name.

nodes.label: Beam to phone (QR code, local web server)
nodes.norm_label: beam to phone (qr code, local web server)

nodes.label: Chat with friends
nodes.rationale: Text base64-encoded to fit ntfy's 4 KB limit; history in chats.json, 300 per friend.

nodes.label: Equalizer that follows the music (WASAPI loopback)
nodes.norm_label: equalizer that follows the music (wasapi loopback)

nodes.label: Friend requests
nodes.rationale: 1.10 keeps requests open until answered (2 days) after late withdrawals were removing friends.

nodes.label: Friends and sealed notes over ntfy.sh
nodes.norm_label: friends and sealed notes over ntfy.sh
nodes.rationale: AES-256-GCM under ECDH P-256 shared key; private key stored with DPAPI.

nodes.label: GIFs in chat (GIPHY)
nodes.rationale: GIPHY key injected at build time from GIPHY_API_KEY secret or ignored giphy.key, never in source.

nodes.label: Invite codes (HOLM-XXXXX-XXXXX)
nodes.rationale: Valid 12 hours; friend card sealed with HKDF-SHA256 + AES-GCM under holm-inv- topic; proof field X lets the notch accept automatically.

nodes.label: Profiles
nodes.rationale: Picture shrunk to 64 px under 1.5 KB so the profile fits in one 4 KB sealed note.

nodes.label: Tailscale detection in VPN indicator
nodes.rationale: Detected by 100.64.0.0/10 or fd7a:115c:a1e0::/48 addresses; route-change listening added so exit-node toggles are noticed at once.

nodes.label: Wi-Fi page and speed test (Cloudflare)
nodes.rationale: Test runs only on Start and stops when leaving the page to bound data use (~600 MB max).

nodes.label: WinNotch renamed to Holm (1.5.1)
nodes.rationale: A holm is a small island; many projects already used WinNotch. Codes and encryption labels unchanged for compatibility.

nodes.label: Beam security model
nodes.rationale: Explicit accept, friends-only presence, sealed notes, AES-256-GCM, relay sees only ciphertext, sanitized names, Mark-of-the-Web; LAN peers unauthenticated so use Code on untrusted networks.

nodes.label: codex/microsoft-store-msix branch
nodes.rationale: Store packaging lives apart from main; main is merged in periodically and before each Store release so portable and packaged versions both keep their behavior.

nodes.label: Minimize/Hide over browser tabs
nodes.rationale: Lets tabs under the notch be clicked; 1.11.1 shrinks to a pill instead of hiding so the notch stays reachable.

nodes.label: Independent collapsed and expanded notch sizes
nodes.norm_label: independent collapsed and expanded notch sizes

nodes.label: Messages (notification center and badges)
nodes.rationale: Copies the notification DB to a temp folder and reads badges from the copy with Windows' SQLite; Teams left out on purpose.

nodes.label: data/store.json
nodes.rationale: Tracks Store version (1.9.0) separately from GitHub's portable version; never copy one into the other.

nodes.label: AI co-author commit convention
nodes.rationale: Preserve the configured Git author while crediting the AI assistant used.

nodes.label: Self-contained single-file Windows x64 release (Holm.exe)
nodes.rationale: Users should not need to install .NET; the asset name stays fixed without version/platform suffixes.

nodes.label: Store-managed updates vs portable updater
nodes.rationale: The Store updates the MSIX app; the in-app updater must be preserved for the GitHub portable build.

nodes.label: Test build naming (Holm-<version>-test-build.<n>.exe)
nodes.rationale: Keeps Holm.exe reserved for release assets so test builds are never mistaken for releases.

nodes.label: Idle CPU and memory optimizations
nodes.rationale: Recurring theme: re-assert topmost only when covered, uncompressed single-file to cut ~106 MB, marker-based notification polling, disabled tiered compilation, memory hand-back to Windows.

nodes.label: Lightweight (event driven, resource figures)
nodes.rationale: Native WPF on .NET 10, event driven updates where Windows allows; notification DB marker checked every 2 s instead of full reads.

nodes.label: Caps Lock Indicator
nodes.rationale: Low-level keyboard hook compares only Caps Lock; no key stored

nodes.label: Color Picker
nodes.rationale: No overlay so the read color is exactly what screen shows

nodes.label: Release Testing under Wine
nodes.rationale: 47 of 727 tests need Windows parts Wine lacks

nodes.label: Calculator
nodes.rationale: Own small parser: nothing typed is run as code

nodes.label: Clipboard History
nodes.rationale: Private-marked clipboard content never read; in-memory only

nodes.label: Copied Password Wipe
nodes.rationale: Compares clipboard sequence number, never reads the password
